answer: Weight each attester by locked stake times tenure, so splitting one stake across n identities leaves every clone 1/n of the influence. A result seals as a pearl only when attesters from k clusters sign it, a cluster being any group with correlated funding or timing. Bonds sit in a haven escrow; if a hidden canary audit proves a pearl false, all k clusters forfeit theirs jointly. A farm posing as an oasis stays one cluster and cannot reach quorum, and buying k clusters costs k full stakes plus k tenures.
